action.command:
echo "=== redirect to keycloak from frontend root (dev server returns index) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:4200/
echo "=== check keycloak discovery ==="; curl -s http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/.well-known/openid-configuration | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('issuer',d['issuer']);print('authorization_endpoint',d['authorization_endpoint'])"
echo "=== Export endpoint ==="; TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token.txt); curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:5000/api/Export
echo "=== backend log tail ==="; ls -la /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/Logs/ 2>/dev/null; tail -5 /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/Logs/*.txt 2>/dev/null
